title: Add Codex /mcp status command
outcome: Expose Codex MCP inventory in the TermAl composer through /mcp and /mcp verbose. Query the owning Codex app-server via mcpServerStatus/list, support local and remote sessions, render server/auth/tool status without sending /mcp as a model prompt, and add backend/frontend regression coverage.
acceptance: Codex sessions expose /mcp; /mcp lists configured MCP servers with auth and tool counts; /mcp verbose exposes tool details; invalid arguments show usage; non-Codex sessions do not expose the control; remote Codex sessions proxy the read; errors and loading are visible; Rust/UI tests and production UI build pass.
